title: Generalized Poincaré inequality for quantum Markov semigroups
summary: We prove a noncommutative $p$-Poincaré inequality for GNS-detailed-balance quantum Markov semigroups (QMSs) on non-tracial $σ$-finite von Neumann algebras, assuming only the existence of a spectral gap. Extending the semi-commutative results of Huang and Tropp, we first establish the inequality for tracial von Neumann algebras. We use Markov dilations to obtain chain-rule estimates for Dirichlet forms and amalgamated free products to define an appropriate noncommutative derivation.
